// Generated by tsv — do not edit. `tsv test` deletes and rewrites this directory on every run.
// Spec: src/orders/order.behavior.yaml (behavior "Order lifecycle")
// Source: finding implementation-property:Order lifecycle:effect-multiplicity:stripe.refund
//   Exactly-once effect `stripe.refund` fires 2 times for one Order.
//   Replays its code-model counterexample against the real code (sidecar: replay-2.json).
import { expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import {
  instrument,
  mappingFromCode,
  planFromTrace,
  type ReplayResult,
  replayResult,
  scheduler,
} from "@tsv/runtime";
import sidecar from "./replay-2.json" with { type: "json" };

declare module "vitest" {
  interface TaskMeta {
    /** Read back by `tsv test`: the verdict, plus the stored status and effect counts it saw. */
    tsvReplay?: ReplayResult & {
      status: unknown;
      effects: Record<string, number>;
    };
  }
}

// (1) Fakes as plain top-level consts (vi.mock is hoisted, but its factory runs lazily).
const s = scheduler();
const db = instrument.store(s, {
  client: "db",
  collections: { orders: { key: "id" } },
  read: ["orders.get"],
  commit: ["orders.save"],
  transaction: "transaction",
});
const email = instrument.effects(s, { client: "email", calls: ["send"] });
const stripe = instrument.effects(s, { client: "stripe", calls: ["refunds.create"] });

// (2) The modules that construct the clients (bindings.clients), relative to this file.
vi.mock("../../../src/db.ts", () => ({ db: db.client }));
vi.mock("../../../src/notify/email.ts", () => ({ email: email.client }));
vi.mock("../../../src/payments/stripe.ts", () => ({ stripe: stripe.client }));

// (3) The impls, imported dynamically after (1).
const { refundOrder } = await import("../../../src/orders/refund.ts");

// (4) Fixtures (the spec's `fixtures`).
const ID = "o1";
const ENTITY = { id: "o1", ownerId: "c1", email: "c1@example.com", chargeId: "ch_1" };
const ACTORS = {
  customer: { id: "c1", roles: [] },
  admin: { id: "a1", roles: ["admin"] },
};

/** One invocation per transition the counterexample's workers perform. */
const INVOKE: Record<string, () => Promise<unknown>> = {
  refund: () => refundOrder({ actor: ACTORS.admin }, ID), // as admin
};

const plan = planFromTrace(sidecar.trace, mappingFromCode(sidecar.code));
// steps 1-2 (checkout#1 atomic, payment_succeeded#1 atomic) fast-forwarded: seed status "paid"
// step 3  refund#1 read   → [refund#1, db.orders.get]
// step 4  refund#2 read   → [refund#2, db.orders.get]
// step 5  refund#1 write  → [refund#1, db.orders.save]
// step 6  refund#2 write  → [refund#2, db.orders.save]
// then each worker runs until done: refund#1, refund#2

const PROPERTY = "effect-multiplicity: exactly-once effect stripe.refund fires at most once (count(effect stripe.refund) <= 1)";

/** The entity's status as stored now. */
function stored(): unknown {
  return db.read("orders", ID)?.status;
}

/** Effect calls by gate: the fast-forwarded prefix's counts plus the calls in this run. */
function observedEffects(): Record<string, number> {
  const counts: Record<string, number> = { ...plan.seedEffects };
  for (const call of s.effects()) counts[call.effect] = (counts[call.effect] ?? 0) + 1;
  return counts;
}

test("replay: effect-multiplicity stripe.refund (refund#1 ∥ refund#2)", async ({ task }) => {
  s.reset();
  db.seed({ orders: [{ ...ENTITY, status: plan.seedStatus }] });
  for (const w of plan.workers) {
    const call = INVOKE[w.transition];
    if (call === undefined) throw new Error(`no invocation for ${w.transition}`);
    s.spawn(w.id, call);
  }
  const outcome = await s.tryPlay(plan.schedule);
  await s.drain();
  const status = stored();
  const effects = observedEffects();
  // effect-multiplicity: exactly-once effect stripe.refund fires at most once (count(effect stripe.refund) <= 1)
  const violated = !((effects["stripe.refunds.create"] ?? 0) <= 1);
  const result = replayResult(outcome, violated);
  task.meta.tsvReplay = { ...result, status, effects };
  const why = `${result.verdict}: the real code violates ${PROPERTY}\n${result.divergence?.message ?? ""}`;
  expect(result.violated, why.trim()).toBe(false);
});
